query: RobyChef - Personal Chef & Catering, St. Petersburg FL
name: RobyChef - Personal Chef & Catering
address_note: Negocio de chef privado a domicilio (sin local/storefront publico). Google Maps no publica una direccion de calle para esta ficha; coords aproximadas 27.8200814,-82.489091 (area metro St. Petersburg / Tampa Bay). Sirve principalmente St. Petersburg y Tampa Bay, hasta Southwest Florida.
hours: Open 24 hours (reservas por evento, no local fisico con horario de atencion)
website_check: robychef.com y www.robychef.com NO resuelven (DNS no encuentra el host, verificado con curl y WebFetch: ENOTFOUND). El dominio aparece mencionado en perfiles de terceros (TakeAChef, collabs.io/GoSolo) como 'su website' pero esta caido/expirado hoy. Google Maps confirma de forma independiente que la ficha NO tiene website (boton 'Add website' visible en gmaps_detail.js). Tratado como has_own_site: false, documentado para transparencia.
fotos_descartadas_nota: La ficha de Maps muestra 35 fotos pero sin sesion iniciada el visor solo entrega 10 URLs base; de esas, 4 (grass-cs y 3 gps-cs-s) llegaron como collage/filmstrip con bandas borrosas superpuestas (glitch del visor publico, no fotos reales utilizables) y se descartaron. Quedan 5 fotos limpias, todas de platillos/mesa de evento, sin texto superpuesto ni selfies.

reviewSamples.text: An incredible tasteful indulgence, Chef Roberta surprised us with a presentation of a cheese wheel, cut table side and torched to melt the cheese and then tossed pasta and shaved truffles in the …

reviewSamples.author: Jessica Hogan
reviewSamples.text: I can't say enough amazing things about Chef Roberta! She is an incredible chef that brings authentic Italian cuisine right to your table. She made a delicious four course dinner for me and my twelve guests. Everyone raved about the food …

reviewSamples.author: Tracy Morrison
reviewSamples.text: We are so lucky we found Roberta and team with Roby Chef. From the first contact I knew our experience was going to be perfect. We selected the four course meal with the wine pairing, which made for such a wonderful experience. We loved how much we learned about the wine and food. I highly recommend this in-house experience.

reviewSamples.author: Joshua Reyes
reviewSamples.text: I hired Roberta for my wife's first Mother's Day and she didn't disappoint. The food and service was outstanding. Its an experience I highly recommend you see for yourself. You won't regret it.

reviewSamples.author: Carmen Pravia
reviewSamples.text: Chef Roberta is so knowledgeable, patient, and friendly! She made my birthday experience at home, one to always remember. The food she helped us cook, was absolutely delicious. After a week, we are still speaking about how delicious it was. …

email_search_note: Busqueda profunda sin exito, fuentes revisadas: (1) ficha de Google Maps (sin email publico, solo telefono), (2) perfil TakeAChef (chef Roberta Massetti y variante 'Roby Fanelli'): sin email, booking via formulario de la plataforma; (3) articulo GoSolo/collabs.io (entrevista a Roberta Massetti): sin email, solo website muerto; (4) Facebook robycheftampa: pagina bloqueada tras muro de login, no se pudo leer About; (5) LinkedIn roberta-massetti-chef: bloqueado (HTTP 999, anti-bot); (6) Instagram robychef_tampa: bloqueado 2 intentos (API privada denegada por sandbox + WebFetch 429), politica del pipeline es no insistir mas de 2 intentos. Canal de contacto recomendado: telefono/WhatsApp +1 727-310-4312 e Instagram @robychef_tampa.
note: Descubierto via gmaps_discover.js barriendo 'catering in St. Petersburg, FL' (85 resultados). Unico candidato que cumplio TODOS los filtros simultaneos: rating>=4.5 (5.0), reviews>=10 (13), SIN boton de website en Maps, y no presente en data/processed.json (verificado por nombre y telefono). Otros nombres sugeridos para doble-chequeo (Bayou Catering, Amici's Catered Cuisine) SI tienen boton de website en Maps (savorthemomentcatering-style, websites propios confirmados en el discovery JSON) y fueron descartados correctamente sin gastar cupo; Elite Events Catering no aparecio en este barrido especifico. Especialidad: chef privado italiano (Bologna/ALMA) para cenas a domicilio, catering de eventos privados en Tampa Bay / St. Petersburg. Sin local fisico: variante adaptada FORGE-BRIEF (direccion->foto real en vez de mapa, precios->'se cotiza, escribenos').
